verdict: Meta efficiency is breaking out; Google's call tracking needs immediate confirmation.
narrative: This period you received 118 leads from Meta at an average cost of $25.60 per lead, and the last 7 days showed that efficiency accelerating — leads up 33% while spend fell 25%, cutting cost per lead nearly in half versus the prior 7-day window. Google Ads ran $1,950.18 in spend over the same 28 days and recorded zero conversions; the data points to a call tracking misconfiguration rather than a campaign failure, and that tracking is being audited now. Separately, 118 leads have entered your pipeline this period but no appointments have been logged, which is a pipeline operations gap we're working through with you. Expect conversion tracking to be tightened and new creative assets to be in market before end of August.
